text:
Landed. Task done.

**Page features from voice — proven live, each with cause**

Tried all five (tabs, columns, place, nav, previews) via the item tool under `/live/demos/`, each twice: once as a LivePage sub-page (what a voice sub-page actually is) and once as a plain Page.

- **tabs** — works on plain Page, broken on LivePage (its `render()` never builds `PageFrame`)
- **columns** — broken either way (`Frame.js` has no case for `navigation:"columns"` at all)
- **place** — works on a fresh plain Page, broken on LivePage (never calls `draw_folder()`)
- **nav (rail)** — works on plain Page, broken on LivePage
- **previews** — broken entirely: no delta reaches it, and calling it directly is refused outright (it needs a DOM, and every write replays in Node first)

Doc with the table, file:line cause and smallest fix per feature: `public/live/doc/page-features.md`, linked from `public/live/readme.md`, committed as `4d9f8d329`. Demo hub at `/live/demos/`. No code changed, per the fence.

Task landed.

## Summary

Built a working `page.ui` prototype at `/live/design/` (public/live/design/: `PageUI.js`, `ui/Tabs.js`, `DesignPage.js`, `DesignPage.css`, `PageUI.test.mjs`):

- **`page.ui.tabs`** is made the first time it's touched (idea 2), only because `DesignPage` imports `./ui/Tabs.js` (idea 1) — nothing else is offered.
- Voice/the item tool (`{"ui":{"tabs":{"selected":"Idea 1"}}}`) switches tabs, saved through the page's log and surviving a reload (shots A/B). A real tap redraws the cards correctly (shot C).
- Test passes: `node public/live/design/PageUI.test.mjs` → 6 assertions.
- Committed the one allowed line (`eb576ceed`, `/live/page.jsonl`'s `pages.add`); the prototype code stays untracked like the rest of `public/live/` (an existing owner gitignore).
- One open caveat, logged in the task: a tap's write-back to disk wasn't observed inside a 3-second headless-Playwright window — the UI and the item-tool round trip are solid, but I couldn't confirm a real click persists within that synthetic session's timing.

On the separate clarity-page-ui note sent to mastermind-page-design about card wording: it rewrote text but didn't edit `cards.json`, so I posted the cards as given in my brief; the mastermind can apply the wording fix as a follow-up edit to the live cards.

Round 2 is done and the log line is written. Per the brief, that's the stop point.

## Summary

Built round 2 of `/live/design/`, "show, don't tell":

- **A widget can sit in a card**: `DesignPage.draw_card` draws `page.ui.get(card.ui)`'s view in the card body when a card has a `ui` field — idea 2 made visible, not described.
- **`ui/MethodMap.js`**: the "150 methods in one bag" census, computed live (Item 37, Page 104 · 51 forward, LivePage 21 in the final shots) with a "today"/"grouped" toggle; grouped regroups Page's own methods by the `namespaces.md` pattern table, and the bucket counts sum to Page's own total exactly (asserted in the test).
- **Cards rewritten**: titles + one-line subtitles, fenced code blocks for the visuals (file trees, the voice line, the three page-storage shapes), plus a new "Pages" tab for the recursive-pages answer.
- Test: `node public/live/design/PageUI.test.mjs` → 10 assertions pass. Shots at 400/1200 of Today, Today-grouped (round-tripped through the item tool), and Pages are in the task dir.
- Committed (`6cfd1fbf7`, `git add -f`, same convention as the mastermind's round-1 commit).

One logged deviation: the brief named the methods widget's field `view`, but that collides with `Item.prototype`'s own `view` accessor and crashes in node — renamed it `mode` and documented why, both in the code and in the task log, for the system architect to weigh in on.
